name: g4-dormancy-residency
description: ENG-80 representative rubble-lane measurement with per-brick terrain colliders: identical to g4-dormancy-settle-120.json (real g4-workload scene/gate rate, 30s warmup + 2-minute measured window, dormancy at the 120-tick default) but with --residency-budget-bricks enabled (tuned via exploratory smoke tests: radius=0 keeps dormancy churn low -- 1/0 in a short smoke run vs 57-117/18 at radius=2-3 -- budget=16 comfortably covers the pinned+interest set, residency_required_over_budget_ticks ~0). Compares tick/physics timing and dormancy churn against the whole-terrain baseline (settle-120: 261/30 deactivations/reactivations, tick p95/p99 9.0-9.5/13.2-20.2 ms across 4 runs) to see what per-brick colliders cost on top of that baseline.
